identificationModule.briefTitle: Exploring Whether Disease-free Intervals Can Guide Endocrine Combined Targeted Therapy for ER+/HER2+ Advanced Breast Cancer (T-sunflower)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Exploring Whether Disease-free Intervals Can Guide Endocrine Combined Targeted Therapy for ER+/HER2+ Advanced Breast Cancer (T-sunflower)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is a prospective, single-arm, phase II clinical study for patients with ER+/HER2+ advanced breast cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Patients with ER+/HER2+ advanced breast cancer are planned to be enrolled. Patients will receive first-line endocrine therapy combined with anti-HER2 therapy. The main purpose is to evaluate whether disease-free intervals can guide first-line endocrine combined targeted therapy for ER+/HER2+ advanced breast cancer.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Depending on the DFI, the subjects will be divided into four groups, namely T0, TS(≤2 years), TM(2-5 years), and TL(≥5 years). All subjects will receive the same treatment regimen.

armGroups.label: T-sunflower group
armGroups.description: Patients will be treated with Trastuzumab, Pyrotinib, Dalpiciclib plus Fulvestrant.

interventions.name: Trastuzumab
interventions.description: 8 mg/kg loading dose IV, then 6 mg/kg IV, every 3 weeks

interventions.name: Dalpiciclib
interventions.description: Dalpiciclib will be given at the dose of 125 mg po q.d. x 21 every 4 weeks

interventions.name: fulvestrant
interventions.description: Fulvestrant will be given intramuscle at the dose of 500 mg every 4 weeks (with an additional 500 mg dose given two weeks after the initial dose.
